About Pass Christian

Living in Pass Christian

Pass Christian sits at the western end of Harrison County, where the Bay of St. Louis meets the Mississippi Sound. It has been a summer destination since the 1800s, and Scenic Drive along the beach is lined with historic homes and live oaks.

The ZIP code also covers land outside city limits, including Henderson Point and areas to the north, so lot sizes and home styles vary a lot.

Getting around

Roads and commute

US 90 runs along the beach and crosses the Bay St. Louis Bridge to Hancock County. Interstate 10 is reached by Menge Avenue and other roads to the north.

Near the water

Flood zones and insurance costs can change from one street to the next on the Coast. Look up any address on FEMA's flood map, and ask me for help getting insurance quotes before you make an offer.
